title: Concise original UI
description:
The original interface is quite cluttered,this resource pack makes the original interface much cleaner and more streamlined
原版界面比较冗余，这个资源包让原界面变得更加简洁护眼。
body:
English:
# Simple Original User Interface
Are you tired of the cluttered and redundant original Minecraft UI? Are you looking for a lightweight optimization solution that doesn't compromise the original feel but significantly improves interface comfort? This "Concise original UI" resource pack is the answer tailor-made for you.

This resource pack is specifically developed for Minecraft Java Edition, with the core design philosophy of "native first, minimalist optimization." We have completely preserved the original UI's operational logic and original visual texture, focusing only on precise subtraction and optimization. Redundant decorative elements, cluttered lines, and ineffective visual distractions have been eliminated, and the interface hierarchy across the entire scene has been reorganized. From the settings menu to the in-game HUD display, every aspect of the interface has been meticulously adjusted, making core function buttons more prominent and information hierarchy clearer. You can easily locate the functions you need while operating, greatly reducing visual fatigue and improving operational efficiency.

Whether it's daily survival exploration, long hours of building, or highly focused redstone circuit debugging, this resource pack provides you with an immersive and uninterrupted gaming experience. This resource pack is developed using a pure native format, allowing for immediate use without requiring additional mods. It won't burden game performance in any way, and even low-spec devices can run it smoothly. It's currently perfectly compatible with the 1.21.x official version and the 26.1.x snapshot version, and is compatible with most mainstream optimized mods such as Optifine and Sodium, with no compatibility conflicts.

Unlike UI enhancement packs on the market that excessively modify mods and deviate from the original feel, we adhere to an optimization approach with zero learning curve. Experienced players need no adjustment period to enjoy a cleaner and smoother interface; new players can also escape the distractions of cluttered interfaces and more easily immerse themselves in the game. If you prefer the native Minecraft experience but want a cleaner, less cluttered interface, this resource pack is the perfect choice.

中文：
# Concise original UI
你是否早已厌倦了Minecraft原版UI的杂乱冗余？是否在寻找一款不破坏原生手感、又能大幅提升界面舒适度的轻量化优化方案？这款「Concise original UI」资源包，正是为你量身打造的答案。

本资源包专为Minecraft Java版开发，核心设计理念是「原生优先，极简优化」。我们完全保留了原版UI的操作逻辑与原生视觉质感，只做精准的减法优化，剔除界面中冗余的装饰元素、杂乱的线条与无效的视觉干扰，重新梳理了全场景的界面层级。从设置菜单，到游戏内HUD显示，每一处界面都经过精细化调整，让核心功能按钮更突出，信息层级更清晰，你能在操作时一眼定位所需功能，大幅减少视觉疲劳，提升操作效率。

无论是日常生存探索、长时间建筑搭建，还是高专注度的红石电路调试，这款资源包都能为你带来无干扰的沉浸式游戏体验。资源包采用纯原生格式开发，即装即用，无需搭配额外模组，不会对游戏性能造成任何额外负担，低配设备也能流畅运行。目前已完美适配1.21.x正式版与26.1.x快照版本，兼容Optifine、Sodium等绝大多数主流优化模组，无兼容性冲突。

不同于市面上过度改模、脱离原版手感的UI美化包，我们坚持零学习成本的优化思路，老玩家无需任何适应期，就能获得更清爽流畅的界面体验；新玩家也能摆脱杂乱界面的干扰，更轻松地沉浸到游戏本身。如果你偏爱MC的原生体验，又想给界面做一次清爽的“减负”，这款资源包会是你的不二之选。
